verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a set of built-in trigger integrations (Kafka, Postgres, NATS, SQS, MQTT, GCP, Azure Event Grid and more) and a passing mention of supported OAuth providers. Otherwise the product is positioned as a code-first engine where you write integration logic yourself in TypeScript, Python and other languages. Missing for 10: any evidence of a catalog of prebuilt, vendor-maintained app connectors at the scale of thousands, connector maintenance or ownership details, and independent corroboration of connector breadth.
